supported_claims: Exact clinical fact precision/recall/F1, omissions and explicit subject/assertion/temporality fields are scored by canonical full-fact matching.
Medication attribute exact match separately compares dose, unit, route, frequency, and other supplied structured attributes; mismatches appear as omission plus unsupported attribute fact.
limitations: Current automated tests use synthetic/developer-authored facts, not independently adjudicated clinical annotations.
Unspecified medication attributes cannot be evaluated; no real clinical performance claim is made.
